title: Melshi
subtitle: Rebel Alliance
description: Ruescott Melshi was imprisoned by the Empire and sent to Narkina-5. That's where he first met Cassian Andor as the pair of them worked to build parts for the still under-construction Imperial war machine. Cassian engineered their escape from the facility and, soon enough, Melshi would become an ally of the Rebel Alliance, fighting on a number of planets, including Wobani and Scarif.
